title: Big Tech Holds $3 Trillion in Spending Commitments for AI Boom

author: Brody Ford
content_snippet: The five largest players in the data center race have committed more than $3 trillion in spending over the coming years …
summary_en: Alphabet, Meta, Microsoft, Amazon, and Oracle have committed over $3 trillion to AI infrastructure in the coming years. Alphabet leads with a $1 trillion pledge, followed by Meta at $800 billion, as these giants race to secure AI dominance through massive data center investments.

title: A Claude model autonomously chose a gene therapy and operated on a mouse brain with no human decision-making
title_en: A Claude model autonomously chose a gene therapy and operated on a mouse brain with no human decision-making
author: THE DECODER
content_snippet:
An AI agent performed brain surgery on an epileptic mouse, picking the drug, the brain target, and the injection coordinates on its own. According to lead researcher Ocana-Santero, it's the first time an AI agent has autonomously chosen a treatment and delivered it to a living mammal. But when a calibration error hit mid-surgery, the agent refused to continue and couldn't be talked out of it.

The article A Claude model autonomously chose a gene therapy and operated on a mouse brain with no huma
summary_en: A Claude-powered AI agent successfully performed brain surgery on an epileptic mouse, autonomously choosing the treatment, target, and injection coordinates. Despite halting operations due to a calibration error, this marks the first time an AI has autonomously treated a living mammal without human intervention.

【起因与机理】验证AI在复杂医疗任务中的自主决策与操作能力
【核心事实细节】AI实现完全自主的脑部手术决策与操作。
【各方立场与态度】AI医疗向无人介入的复杂操作迈出重要一步。
fact_bullets_en: [Core Event] Claude AI agent (Mouse brain surgery laboratory): Autonomously selected treatment and performed precise brain injection
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Testing AI's autonomous decision-making in complex medical procedures
[Key Technical Spec] AI achieves fully autonomous surgical decision-making.
[Key Position & Outlook] Milestone for AI in complex, human-free medical procedures.

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 在一个实验性场景中，Claude驱动的AI智能体成功为患有癫痫的小鼠实施了脑部手术。该智能体全程自主决策，包括选择药物、确定靶点及操作注射坐标，虽然在过程中因校准错误导致智能体自我终止手术，但该事件标志着AI首次在无需人类介入的情况下，完成对活体哺乳动物的临床治疗操作。

author: Financial Times
content_snippet: North Korean hackers' attack on Binance takes crypto theft to an unprecedented scale — The largest financial theft in history took no more than 30 minutes.

title: Malicious Claude Code extension in Cursor's marketplace attempted remote access and data theft
title_en: Malicious Claude Code extension in Cursor's marketplace attempted remote access and data theft
author: THE DECODER
content_snippet:
A tampered Claude Code extension was live on the Cursor marketplace for about 11 hours, affecting up to 5,000 users. It tried to steal user data and set up remote access. Cursor took the entire marketplace offline and reinstated it after confirming there was no further risk.

The article Malicious Claude Code extension in Cursor's marketplace attempted remote access and data theft appeared first on The Decoder.

author: MIT Tech Review
content_snippet:
Eating disorders are on the rise. GLP-1s could make things worse.

GLP-1 weight-loss drugs are one of the biggest biotech breakthroughs of the last decade. But to some clinicians, they can represent something sinister—a potential trigger for eating disorders.

paragraphs_zh: 专为会计师事务所与税务咨询机构打造专业 AI 操作系统的前沿初创公司 Ravical 宣布完成 1700 万美元种子轮融资，资金将用于核心产品研发与跨国业务扩张。本轮由 MMC Ventures 领投，现有投资方 Lakestar 与 Pitchdrive 持续追投，新投资机构 Shapers 参投，使其累计融资金额攀升至 2500 万美元。
Ravical 于 2025 年由首席执行官乔里斯·范德古赫特（Joris Van Der Gucht）、首席技术官肯·巴斯蒂安森（Ken Bastiaensen）与首席产品官本杰明·范德马利尔（Benjamin Vandermarliere）联合创立。平台通过 AI 算法将资深审计师与财税专家的隐性业务认知沉淀为标准化的端到端执行流，并在整个客户群中规模化复制。
公司旨在攻克财税服务业长期面临的根本结构性矛盾：虽然企业客户对高附加值财税咨询的需求激增，但事务所却饱受专业人才招募难、流失率高的困扰；与此同时，通用生成式 AI 工具的普及正在彻底重塑客户获取基础财务信息的习惯。
Ravical 最新行业调研指出，英国高达 70% 的中小型企业（SME）目前已开始在未咨询专属会计师的情况下直接采纳 AI 生成的财务与税务建议。这一剧烈转变倒逼财税机构必须迅速重构服务模式，强化不可替代的专业顾问壁垒。
Ravical 的核心理念是协助财税机构以“组织级体系”统一导入 AI，杜绝员工各自使用碎片化工具的散兵游勇状态。通过将所内顶级合伙人的专业经验转化为全员共享的智能工作流，大幅提速交付周期，防范审计合规差错。
Ravical 联合创始人兼 CEO 强调：“当每个员工各自使用自己的 AI 助手时，个体效率或许有所微调，但事务所整体的竞争力并未发生质变。我们的平台是将事务所最优秀合伙人的思考逻辑转化为全机构共享的标准操作体系，由 AI 在每位客户的项目中精准贯彻。”
目前欧洲已有超过 100 家顶尖会计师事务所接入 Ravical 平台。本轮融资将助力其加速产品迭代，并在英国、比利时、荷兰与德国设立分支机构，随后进军更广阔的泛欧市场并开拓美国业务。

title: CrowdStrike: China-linked hackers used AI tool ARTEX with a DeepSeek LLM and another model to target 200+ organizations in 11 days, compromising at least nine (Kevin Collier/NBC News)
title_en: CrowdStrike: China-linked hackers used AI tool ARTEX with a DeepSeek LLM and another model to target 200+ organizations in 11 days, compromising at least nine (Kevin Collier/NBC News)
author: NBC News
content_snippet: The DeepSeek AI mobile app.Andrey Rudakov / Bloomberg via Getty Add NBC News to GoogleOct. 29, 2026, 6:00 PM EDTBy Kevin CollierChinese state-linked hackers used artificial intelligence, including the popular DeepSeek model, to launch cyberattacks against more than 200 organizations around the world in just 11 days, according to the cybersecurity company CrowdStrike, in a campaign that illustrates how AI is allowing hackers to operate on a scale that previously required far more human effort.
summary_en: Threat actors deployed an automated tool named ARTEX, integrated with the DeepSeek LLM and an additional model, to target over 200 global organizations within just 11 days, successfully breaching at least nine. The campaign leverages generative AI to dramatically compress the reconnaissance and exploit lifecycle, demonstrating how LLMs transform labor-intensive cyber intrusions into scalable, industrialized operations.

title: Our climate models have a big, dangerous blind spot
title_en: Our climate models have a big, dangerous blind spot
author: MIT Tech Review
content_snippet:
Climate change itself is increasingly fueling climate change. Rising concentrations of greenhouse gases are driving up global temperatures, setting off dangerous feedback loops that we have not fully accounted for in our climate models—or our emissions-reduction goals.

Scientists have long warned that warming would propel further warming in various ways, but a growing number of observations and studies are at last providing a sharper sense of just how powerful these cascading effects could be.

title: Go 100 mph and Snap It: How a Teen Game Sparked Today’s Social Media Reckoning
title_en: Go 100 mph and Snap It: How a Teen Game Sparked Today’s Social Media Reckoning
author: Olivia Carville
content_snippet: The rain had only just let up when the night shift ended at the Bay Breeze Seafood Restaurant in Lovejoy, Georgia.
summary_en: A landmark lawsuit over a catastrophic car crash spurred by Snapchat's speed filter has successfully pierced the industry's Section 230 liability shield, ruling that negligent product design is actionable. The case established that app features incentivizing reckless behavior hold tech companies liable as product manufacturers. This legal precedent has triggered a nationwide reckoning, paving the way for hundreds of current suits holding social giants accountable for algorithm-driven harm.

【起因与机理】平台为争夺注意力推出将真实危险游戏化的滤镜功能，直接导致严重交通事故并危及公共安全

title_zh: 芯片利润不达标且开支激增 三星股价重挫逾6%
summary_zh: 三星电子股价盘中重挫达6.6%，主因半导体部门盈利不及预期、资本支出激增且未推出新的股东回报计划
fact_bullets_zh: 【核心事件】三星电子在韩国首尔证券交易所与季度财报电话会议：股价盘中暴跌多达6.6%，芯片部门利润不及预期，且未宣布任何额外股东回报方案
【起因与机理】巨额资本开支引发利润率担忧，同时股东对现金分红落空的失望情绪加剧了抛售
【关键数据与实测】三星电子股价盘中暴跌6.6%，回吐早盘全部涨幅。
【各方立场与态度】资本支出大幅扩张加重市场对利润率恶化的避险情绪。
fact_bullets_en: [Core Event] Samsung Electronics: Shares plummeted up to 6.6% due to chip unit profit miss and lack of new shareholder returns
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Concerns over cash drag from massive capex coupled with disappointment over absent capital returns
[Key Metrics] Samsung shares tumbled up to 6.6%, erasing earlier session gains.
[Key Position & Outlook] Escalating capex ignited fears of margin compression and cash drain.

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 三星电子在最新财报发布后股价盘中剧烈跳水，跌幅一度高达6.6%，抹平早盘全部涨幅。半导体芯片部门利润未达市场预期，加之公司大幅增加资本支出却未宣布任何新的股票回购或分红计划，直接引发了投资者的抛售狂潮。市场对巨额资本投入短期内难以变现、反而大幅稀释现金流和利润率的前景表现出强烈担忧。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Samsung Electronics shares slumped as much as 6.6%, wiping out earlier gains following its latest earnings and business update. The steep selloff was triggered by the chip division missing profit expectations, paired with a surge in planned capex and the complete absence of a new shareholder return plan. Investors reacted swiftly, alarmed that massive cash outlays without immediate dividend or buyback offsets would heavily drag down near-term margins and cash flow.
